  "blocking_defect": true,
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "category": "D consequence linkage or verification guidance beyond T",
      "blocking": true,
      "finding": "The D settlement surface states that the two implementation-time deltas require a decision before acceptance and that the repaired compile error and unrelated warning do not currently indicate a semantic failure. Those are acceptance/verification conclusions, not only selected facts or compressed chronology.",
      "allowed_by_frozen_plan": false,
      "execution_impact": "Under v2 as written, D-vs-T cannot be interpreted as a clean selective-delta settlement-form effect because D supplies consequence linkage and noise-reduction guidance absent from T."
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "category": "condition-packet meta language",
      "blocking": false,
      "finding": "All initial packet templates mention audit retrieval, no future corrective turns or oracle annotation, and that recipients are not told which facts are consequential. If this wrapper is recipient-visible in Stage A, it introduces protocol awareness common across conditions.",
      "allowed_by_frozen_plan": "partial",
      "execution_impact": "This is not fixture-specific answer leakage, but it may increase ceiling/guessing effects and should be separated from pure settlement-surface exposure if used."
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "category": "index labels",
      "blocking": false,
      "finding": "The S01 index labels name evidence objects: final implementation diff, compile log, targeted test log, validation tool history, executor local note, and final implementation report. They do not encode answers such as should reject, unauthorized, or D_now+.",
      "allowed_by_frozen_plan": true,
      "execution_impact": "Index appears acceptable for Stage B as an object-naming surface, not as an answer-revealing scoring label."
    },
    {
      "id": "F4",
      "category": "audit payload oracle language or future holdout leakage",
      "blocking": false,
      "finding": "S01-R1 through S01-R6 contain factual artifact, log, history, local note, and report content. They do not contain explicit oracle scoring labels, required-action language, future corrective holdout turns, or conclusions equivalent to should reject or should accept.",
      "allowed_by_frozen_plan": true,
      "execution_impact": "No obvious recipient-visible oracle leakage is present in the provided S01 audit payloads."
    },
    {
      "id": "F5",
      "category": "synthetic artifact consistency",
      "blocking": false,
      "finding": "S01 payloads are broadly internally consistent: compile log repair precedes successful build, test dates match yyyyMMdd parsing, V_legacy substitution and absent V_authoritative result match the diff, and the final report claims only compilation/test success without mentioning provenance issues. One nonmaterial completeness caveat: R1 as a final diff does not explicitly display the local type repair described in R2.",
      "allowed_by_frozen_plan": true,
      "execution_impact": "The caveat should be logged as an artifact-completeness limitation, but it does not appear to create answer leakage or undermine the two consequential deltas."
    },
    {
      "id": "F6",
      "category": "synthetic versus naturalistic boundary",
      "blocking": false,
      "finding": "S01 is synthetic and uses precommitted terms such as V_authoritative, V_legacy, and yyyyMMdd. The oracle status identifies it as candidate replay fixture, not historical transcript or study result.",
      "allowed_by_frozen_plan": true,
      "execution_impact": "S01 results should be read as apparatus or variance evidence, not naturalistic replication."
    }
  ],
  "interpretation_limits": [
    "Recipient exposure should not proceed under this packet version for a clean gamma-I settlement-form comparison unless the D guidance issue is removed in v3 or consequence linkage/guidance is explicitly factorialized.",
    "If runs are nevertheless collected, any D advantage cannot be attributed to fact selection or compression alone because D also provides acceptance and verification guidance.",
    "Residual confounding remains permitted: T chronology can support inference, D selection/compression can change salience, and the common audit index creates a post-initial information surface.",
    "Initial settlement performance, post-index selection behavior, and post-payload final performance must be reported separately; post-index discoveries must not be credited to the original settlement surface.",
    "The provided material review is limited to S01. No claim is made about C13 or SH2 recipient-visible audit payloads, indices, or consistency because those materials are not present in this excerpt.",
    "Content review cannot verify runtime isolation, hash verification, fresh-context creation, deterministic payload retrieval, or scorer separation; those remain preflight gates.",
    "Volume metrics remain exposure/cost proxies only and should not be interpreted as evidence of cognitive effort."
  ]
}
